title: Snapshot and Attach Packet Ingestion Rules

snapshot_rules.eligibility: Snapshot created at phase close when Context Space is active (long-horizon projects)
content_rules: Blocker status delta (what changed, not full history)
Active blockers only (not resolved, not accepted)

attach_packet_rules.eligibility: Attach Packet created for Native Build Pro, long-horizon, recovery, or native agent start
content_rules: Minimal memory records for last N phases (N configurable, default 5)
Phase ledger delta since last attach
